findings.description: get_help_record now always returns a tuple, but when self.help is None it returns (metavar, None) instead of an empty description as the docstring promises. The previous fallback to an empty string was removed.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where at least one Argument has help set and another has help=None, which is the normal case. format_arguments passes every record to formatter.write_dl, which processes the second element as text (wrapping/len), so None raises a TypeError or AttributeError. The result is that --help crashes for such commands.
